item.description:
Controller 1.0.6 adds provider usage reporting, answers agents' MCP questions and tightens the conversation view.
- See each provider account's usage on a new Usage page in Settings, and how full a conversation's context is in the composer. - Answer MCP questions and tool approvals from Codex, Claude, Grok and OpenCode inside the thread. - Create isolated checkouts as copy-on-write clones, with linked worktrees as the fallback, and see checkout names in the sidebar. - Open New Thread as a centered palette. - Show skill loads, Cursor subagent work, Claude's retries and limits, and Grok's billing and turn costs more clearly. - Handle more Codex, Claude and OpenCode 2.0.7 events, and explain harness failures using their last error output. - Keep streaming from re-rendering the composer, slow busy harnesses instead of stopping them, and stop a harness's processes when it or the app quits. - Smooth the sidebar's archive and settle animations.
Requires macOS 27 and Apple silicon. Coding tools are installed separately.

Controller 1.0.5 improves Git workflows and remote access.
- Browse repository files and Git state from connected mobile clients. - Expand repository operations with pull request lifecycle, review threads, and stacked pull request support. - Configure Git actions when starting a new thread, with app defaults and per-project overrides. - Improve shared mobile navigation, conversation controls, and list behavior.
Requires macOS 27 and Apple silicon. Coding tools are installed separately.

Controller 1.0.4 improves pull request browsing and conversation transcripts.
- Open and review pull requests in the main workspace, with review filters independent of the thread sidebar. - See all tool calls in a scrollable list with clearer details. Edit diffs now include file headers and aligned line numbers. - Completed work folds as the final reply begins, with clearer reasoning and reply phases. - Restore the working timeline when a new local chat starts after an empty draft was discarded.
The Controller iPhone and iPad client also has updated navigation, new chat placement, conversation titles, and composer controls. That client is distributed separately.
Requires macOS 27 and Apple silicon. Coding tools are installed separately.
